verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence mentions testing support, but the framework exposes the injection points a test would need. Custom tools are plain Tool subclasses with a `forward` method, so stubs are easy to write. The model is a pluggable constructor argument that accepts any LLM backend, and `agent.step()` lets a test drive the agent one step at a time. Missing for 10: any documented mock/fake model class, testing guide or utilities, examples of asserting on agent behavior in unit tests, and independent corroboration of testing workflows.
